AN OVERLOOKED LOCAL RESOURCE

Conch is iconic.
The shell has more to give.

Across The Bahamas, conch shell remains after the meat is removed. Much of it has limited commercial use and can accumulate around docks, coastlines and disposal areas.

We are building the equipment, products and supply relationships to turn that familiar material into considered inputs for agriculture and other markets.

Why we started

Recover.
Prepare.
Prove the use.

There is more in a conch shell than the meal it leaves behind. We are bringing that material into new uses, beginning with a local calcium source for poultry and exploring where else it could belong.

See our approach

OUR STORY IN PROGRESS

Made here.
Made to matter.

Bahama Mineral Co. began with a simple idea: make more of what The Bahamas already has. With local roots and early support, we are turning that idea into a materials company with room to grow.
